comment: I'm not sure if professor Angel can be described in a review. He's just the realest professor. The most caring and the one that ACTUALLY wants to see you succeed. His class is one of the only ones you actually wait for and enjoy. Taking two classes with him, and I will miss him no doubt. Gracias profe, muchisimas gracias!

I love Angel. He makes all of his classes engaging and really loves what he teaches. His classes are discussion-based, meaning we don't have too much work outside of class except the poetry readings that we talk about. A couple papers, midterm, and take-home final. Very doable, and helpful in developing your Spanish comprehension.
Angel is very very nice and funny, I actually looked forward to his class everyday. Pretty easy grader, but you learn a lot in the class. Great professor.

absolutely amazing prof. so sweet and caring and understanding of extenuating circumstances. extremely manageable workload and easy class. can't recommend angel enough i hope im able to take him again!!!

Can't say enough good things about Angel. Very light on homework, and a really easy grader. He never makes you feel stupid or bad at Spanish, and he's extremely accommodating about extensions or absences. Learned a lot, but felt minimal stress. TAKE HIS CLASS

I HAVE ZERO IDEA WHY ANYONE WOULD RATE ANXO LESS THAN 5! He is the best professor I ever had in my entire academic career. He is extremely understanding, inclusive, energetic, engaging, LITERALLY everything! I would take his class over and over again. Apart from an easy A, he makes you want to go to class and actually participate. TAKE HIM NOW!

YOU MUST TAKE THIS CLASS WITH PROFESSOR OTERO-BlANCO! This man has changed my perspective on language courses. He is arguably the best prof on campus and anyone who has had him will agree. Normal workload and he will make sure everyone understands before moving on. TAKE HIS CLASS!

Angel is the type of professor that makes you want to go to class. I had him for Spanish 151, and though the class material was difficult, he found a way to make it engaging and fun. Angel gained respect from every student by treating them as an equal, as a friend, rather than a student. If you have the opportunity to take his class, TAKE IT.

Angel is such a caring professor. English is his second language, so he understands how hard it is to learn a new language. He always has a smile on his face and works hard to get to know every student. He is always joking around and laughing and just wants everyone to love the class. He is flexible, and won't move on unless everyone understands.

I really wish Angel taught more classes outside of Iberian studies. If you make any kind of effort to engage yourself in his class, you won't regret it. SparkNotes the books, whatever, just know what's going on and participate. He is legitimately interested in what you have to say even if only tangentially related to the topic.

Angel is so much fun! Class time is very enjoyable. He loves to joke around. He will grade your first assignment pretty hard to see if you're committed enough to improving. He is more than willing to meet outside of class and help you with your essays. And he genuinely cares about improving students' spanish skills. You won't regret his class!
Angel is a great person and I would highly recommend taking his class purely because he will make your day better.  The class, however, was boring some days and his grading is very subjective.
He is SO AWESOME! So much fun and wants his students to succeed! Love him.

Best professor for my first semester! Really helpful and interesting. Reading and writing is not a lot for a fys class. He is good at making a hilarious atmosphere for his students. To be honest, it is the only class that I can remember everyone! Take his class if you can!

Angel is the best professor I have had so far at UR. He is kind, intriguing, very helpful and truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. A little quirky but in an enjoyable manner. Meets with his students and tries hard to get to know them and make them comfortable. Amazing professor, makes the material interesting.

Angel is GREAT! Easily the best LAIS professor I have had. He truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. I had almost no interest in Spanish literature prior to this class, but he makes it fun and easy to understand. His is a very fair grader and gives helpful comments on assignments. Take a class with him if you can!

Angel is one my favorite prof at UR! He is the friendliest man out there. Spanish is not my thing, but he made me want to come to class. He teaches in a easy to understand way that make Spanish Fun! He wants you to do well and he will do anything to ensure that you excel. There is no better prof to take 221 with especially if you struggle in LAIS

Angel  rocks! He’s a super guy, personable, warm and supportive. There’s lots of camaraderie between students and professor. I thought the class would be a drag, but thanks to Angel, it turned out to be a good experience. Do whatever you can to take his class, even if it means waiting for a semester that he’s teaching.  Angel is the absolute man!

Angel is by the far the nicest person you will EVER meet. He really is understanding and willing to help the students who definitely bond with him as the semester goes on. His exams can be tough if you're not prepared but he's very clear on just about everything and you WILL learn from him. Great professor and probably best Spanish teacher at UR.

Best teacher for 221 if your not a language person. The nicest man you will ever meet, along with being very funny and understanding. Four tests, not super easy so study. You will not get an easier teacher for 221. Also, you learn ALOT!
the man.  class really bonds together and with him.  i looked forward to class whether i had completed the reading or not.
Angel is inspiring, funny, and a great prof. Class flies by. He inspires you to work hard and doesn't grade harshly.

He's an incredible teacher! He's enthusiastic, fun, and will make you excited to go to class. He's not very hard at all but you will learn to read text closely. Without a doubt, I would recommend him to anyone. He is one of the best teachers at Richmond!

Angel is the most understanding and kind Professor you might ever have. His lectures are meaningful and fun. You will rarely be bored! The work itself is sensible. Read the stories and write the essays when you are supposed to.  He really knows how to brighten up your day with the course. So take it. Seriously.
